description: Kijai's refiner-only rank-384 extraction (5.9 GB, bf16) of NVlabs' Open-H3-Regenerate-2K (Efficient-Large-Model/Open-H3-Regenerate-2K): a high-sigma regenerate pass over an upscaled 768p draft. Linears only - NVlabs' sharp_curve_branches.safetensors (AdaLN branches on a timestep curve) is not a LoRA and is not loaded, nor is the merge's LMS half. Leave lora_alpha unset: the file's own alphas scale it (see the mixed-rank note in instantx-turbo-4step). Trained on the keyframe partition
use_when: Probe only (#1065): on the refine step of the guide's H3LatentUpscaleRefine recipe, stacked with turbo-4step-keyframe, refine_strength 0.909375, num_inference_steps 4, shift about 2 (the recipe's exact sigmas need refine_sigmas, #1065 stage B)
